correctness.rationale: The set {|x|^m<delta} is (-delta^(1/m),delta^(1/m)); after delta^epsilon thickening it is the interval centered at zero with radius R=delta^(1/m)+delta^epsilon. For 0<delta<1, delta^a<=R<=2delta^a with a=min(epsilon,1/m). Standard triadic endpoint-cylinder bounds give mu([0,r]) asymptotic comparable to r^s, s=log(2)/log(3). Therefore F(delta) comparable to delta^(sa), proving exact beta*=s min(epsilon,1/m), including the equality epsilon=1/m. No finite experiment is needed.
